title: Kenworth K200 FUPS Compliant Road Train Custom Built Bullbar #78
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile polished aluminium custom built FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar, Texas style main channel and heavy duty box uprights with 76mm pipes std. option of 88mm or100 pipe available. Combination LED indicator/daylight running /park lights in outer uprights. Main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs. A lift assist spring is fitted to aid easy access for cab tilt. Additional wombat flap and mounting plate to suit 17 auxiliary ED front clearance lights to lower main channel. Driving light mounts to customer requirements.
